rationale: PINS the imports relationship kind (#419 section B — previously unpinned in ANY java fixture, so a regression that deleted the import edge would be silent). Java semantics (JLS 7.5): each import declaration produces a dependency on the imported module; single imports carry the full dotted target (java.util.List, never the truncated java.util), wildcard imports (Map.*) carry the parent module with isWildcard, static imports (static java.util.Collections.sort) carry the full static member path. The edge is emitted as references with meta.isJavaImport (the taxonomy in Matrix 1c: imports persist to brain_import + reference edges). Evidence tier per the shared taxonomy: import-derived edges are import_based (matching groovy); java emitted reference_qualified because the classifier only recognized isGroovyImport/isImport — fixed 2026-08-26.
